about: The song's editions, read by tools/sing_site.py (docs/SING-ONLINE.md, 'Editions'). The home page (now.itsby.you) offers the newest; /history offers every one, newest first. To add one, add it at the end: id (letters, digits, -), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it's released; one a day), render (the packed render, from the checkout), audio (the start of its id, at least 12 characters), commit (the program it came from), note (a sentence on what changed).

editions.title: The first version
editions.note: The song as it began, shaped by the people who sang along to it online.
